biomarkers.name: Complex karyotype (no specific fusion)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports distinction from paediatric fusion-driven alveolar RMS; pleomorphic RMS lacks a recurrent defining fusion

biomarkers.name: MyoD1, myogenin, desmin
biomarkers.prevalence: Usually positive for desmin and MyoD1; myogenin often focal/variable

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Pleomorphic spindle and epithelioid cells with rhabdomyoblastic differentiation identifiable by IHC

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Pleomorphic cellular architecture; often extensive necrosis

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Adult mesenchymal cells with skeletal muscle differentiation potential — distinct from paediatric RMS biology
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Pleomorphic spindle and epithelioid cells with rhabdomyoblastic differentiation identifiable by IHC (MyoD1+, myogenin variable)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Adult-onset entity with complex karyotype; distinct biology from paediatric RMS despite same rhabdomyoblastic differentiation; may represent skeletal muscle-directed differentiation of adult undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma
